about: The sounds, the same for both builds. Each is a short WAV file: one channel, 16 bits, 22,050 samples a second. Play a sound once, from its start, each time its moment comes. Sounds may overlap.

gust.plays_when: Gust is cast and clears a tile

break_ground.plays_when: Break Ground is cast and turns a tile to soil

sprout.plays_when: Sprout is cast and plants a seed

draw.plays_when: Draw is cast and waters a tile

sell.plays_when: the crops are sold at the crate

level_up.plays_when: a school of magic gains a level
